entries.ccbea1c6fdf36270: Under its corporate philosophy, the company has expanded its business centered on data centers, cloud solutions and data solutions. Going forward, it will create an environment in which users can utilize each service across services flexibly, and will advance its transformation into a business model as a "DX Center" that supports the storage, processing and utilization of data in an integrated manner. In data centers, in addition to urban-type facilities in Tokyo and Osaka, it plans to open a suburban data center in Ishikari, Hokkaido, in September 2026, powered 100% by renewable energy, and will also promote an asset-light business model utilizing a collaborative structure among companies. In the Media Solutions Business, it will advance the smooth transition to next-generation broadcasting services and expand its businesses related to disaster prevention and local information distribution for local governments.
